summary: Haleon plc filed a Form 6-K reporting routine share buyback transactions under its existing buyback programme announced on 12 March 2026. The registrant purchased 12,171,987 ordinary shares at prices between 333.8p and 360.0p per share for cancellation, totalling approximately £XX million. No special-situation event such as a tender offer, going-private transaction, or restructuring is involved. The filing is a routine capital return through open-market purchases under a disclosed programme and does not constitute an event-driven special situation for classification purposes.
